title: Pre-Analysis — Extended Cargo Compartment Suppression Discharge for 240-Minute Diversion
abstract: Original pre-analysis for the third metering stage and rebalanced distribution manifold that take the cargo compartment suppression discharge from 180 to 240 minutes, closed with conditions on two adjacent programmes.

sections.objective: Establish what the third metering stage and the rebalanced distribution manifold disturb in the lower deck compartments, and confirm that the sustaining concentration can be held for the longer diversion on every configuration in the target effectivity. The work order had to check the manifold routing against everything else committed under and around the compartment linings, and to confirm that the bottle installation in the centre dry bay leaves the existing access provisions intact.
sections.findings_summary: Four items were confirmed and one is a genuine blocker. The freighter hard point provisioning reinforces the floor panels the manifold runs beneath and changes the panel underside clearance at three stations; the routing has never been drawn against the reinforced edge and the two programmes were on different review cycles. The floor panel installation task carries the panel-to-manifold clearance implicitly, through a torque and shimming sequence that assumes the present standoff. The bilge cleaning task is a smaller matter but it sprays into the same two zones and the new manifold brings a metering orifice into the sprayed area. The fourth result was found only through the dry bay zone: the centre tank boost pump low pressure procedure uses the same access panel the third stage bottle now sits behind, and the two documents have no wording in common at all.
sections.next_steps: Draw the manifold routing against the reinforced floor panel edge with the provisioning design office, and treat it as a joint deliverable rather than a coordination note. Add a standoff dimension to the floor panel installation task so the clearance is explicit. Mask the metering orifice in the bilge cleaning task. Confirm the boost pump access remains within reach with the third stage bottle installed, and record the answer in the troubleshooting procedure rather than leaving it to the mechanic.

similarity_seeds: sustaining concentration held across a longer overwater diversion
metering orifice and manifold balance in a lower deck compartment

tasks.title: Trace the manifold routing against committed floor work
Check compartment tasks that spray or clean into the manifold area
Confirm dry bay access with the third stage bottle installed
Verify sustaining concentration across every cabin configuration

expected_findings.rationale: The provisioning reinforces the panel edges the manifold runs beneath and changes the underside clearance at three stations. Neither design has been drawn against the other, and on an aircraft carrying both the manifold would be installed to a clearance that no longer exists.
expected_findings.resolution: Make the routing a joint deliverable with the provisioning design office before either is frozen.

expected_findings.rationale: The floor panel installation carries the panel-to-manifold clearance implicitly, through a torque and shimming sequence written for the present standoff. Nothing in the task states the dimension, so it is lost the moment either side changes.
expected_findings.resolution: Add an explicit standoff dimension to the installation task.

expected_findings.rationale: The bilge wash and dry task sprays into the same two zones and the rebalanced manifold brings a metering orifice into the sprayed area. Inhibitor or wash residue in an orifice is not visible and changes the balance the substantiation depends on.
expected_findings.resolution: Add a masking step for the metering orifice to the cleaning task.

expected_findings.rationale: The centre tank boost pump procedure uses the access panel the third stage bottle now sits behind. The two documents share no vocabulary — one is a fuel pressure procedure, the other a suppression distribution change — and only the dry bay zone connects them.
expected_findings.resolution: Confirm the access remains within reach and record the answer in the procedure.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares both lower deck compartment zones and appears in every zone-driven search over this bay. It is the frame and frame foot parts figure for the bilge area; no suppression item appears in it and the manifold is supported off the floor beams, not the frames.

type_data.conclusion: The extended discharge is sound. The manifold routing must be drawn jointly with the freighter provisioning and three maintenance items updated.
